_comment: One entry per Postgres database ZMRP users can switch to. See db_profiles.py.
host/port are as seen FROM THE CONTAINER (localhost/127.0.0.1 there is the container itself).
match_hosts: other spellings of the same server that ZMRP clients might use
(IP, FQDN, 'localhost' if ZMRP runs on the Postgres box). Matching is case-insensitive.
password_env: name of an environment variable (in .env) holding that DB's password.
Passwords never go in this file. Edits are picked up without a restart.
